statement: Analyze the eight row-tail sources that survived the 256M resumable generation to identify exact shared structure, invariants, or row-specific reductions that can eliminate or compress the giant individual strata.

scope.population: the exact eight FULL178 hard-tail row sources retained by generation38 diagnostics
scope.field_or_model: Stage32 residual prefix/indexed Picard search state
scope.quantifiers: all retained hard-tail source rows at the cited checkpoint
scope.required_output: exact structural classification and at least one replayable reduction/blocker diagnosis per row family

notes: Do not infer global FULL178 closure from eight-row behavior.
Do not spend another blind 256M wave as the primary research action.
